notes.title: Enjoy Some Winter Wonder with Our Latest Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]With all this festive spirit in the air, we feel it’s time to prop up the candy canes, hang the stockings, and start making those snow angels in our merry new hub.


👇 Check out the changes here in this video or go see for yourself![/h3]
[previewyoutube=C7_vPUcSu30;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s not just the hub that we’ve made changes to.

We’ve also added some quality of life changes to keep those puzzles puzzling.

[list]
[*] A new journal feature, which can be opened by pressing [b]J[/b]. In the journal, you can either draw or type out notes to keep track of anything you like. The drawing section includes a pen with 2 sizes, an eraser with 2 sizes, and a clear button.

[*] A reworked hint system. Hints are no longer on a 5 minute timer, but instead are available the moment a puzzle starts. Some hints are now marked as Solutions since they give away the answer to the puzzle. These solution hints are on an 8 minute timer before they unlock and are visually displayed with a gold frame. The menu has also been reworked into a carousel style to allow for more than 5 hints if required in the future. Hints can be navigated by pressing A or D, or clicking the left or right side of the screen. The menu can also now be closed by pressing H again.

[*] Pings have been added. Pressing the [b]middle mouse button (Mouse button 3)[/b] will visually mark the object/wall for both players. The ping is visible through walls, scales with distance, and will fade out after a few seconds.

[*] All new features can be rebound in the settings menu.
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858650/In_Sink_A_Coop_Escape_Adventure/

[h3]Fan of our first update?

Let us know your thoughts in our Discord or on social media![/h3]

notes.title: Patch #1: A few bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Puzzles weren't the only things hiding in the portals...

We found some pesky bugs too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858650/In_Sink_A_Coop_Escape_Adventure/

Here’s a list of the bug fixes included in Build 1.0.1:

[list]
[*] Added missing SFX in Level 2
[*] Removed an invisible interactable from Level 2
[*] Fixed shadow flickering on objects in level 4
[*] Fixed shadow flickering caused by camera panning near candles in level 7
[*] Fixed an issue where a button toward the end of Level 1 failed to highlight properly
[*] Adjusted the "vision" doors in Level 3 to remain open as long as either player was looking at an eye
[*] Blocked players from interacting with each others panels in Level 6
[*] Improved the resolution of various UI elements
[*] Fixed a potential soft lock caused by backtracking toward the end of Level 5
[*] Fixed an issue where a puzzle on level 5 could increase in time infinitely
[*] Fixed an issue where the a spinner on Level 8 didn't lock after completing it
[*] Fixed a rare desync issue on Level 2 where the large players door failed to open after the small player completed a puzzle
[/list]
Thank you so much to all of the players who have been reporting bugs! Without your help, we wouldn't have been able to find and fix these bugs so quickly.

If you encounter any more bugs, please let us know either in the Bug Reports sub-forum of our Steam Forum or in our Discord!
